MASTER SUPPLY AND DISTRIBUTION AGREEMENT

This Master Supply and Distribution Agreement (the "Agreement") is made between
Aurelian Components SA ("Supplier") and Pinnacle Motorworks Inc ("Distributor").

1. DEFINITIONS

1.1 "Products" means the components listed in Schedule A, as amended from time
to time by written agreement of the parties.

1.2 "Territory" means the countries listed in Schedule B.

1.3 "Forecast" means the rolling twelve-month volume estimate supplied by
Distributor under Section 4.

2. APPOINTMENT

2.1 Distributor shall use commercially reasonable efforts to promote the Products throughout the Territory.

2.2 Supplier shall not be obliged to accept any purchase order that deviates from the then-current Forecast by more than twenty percent (20%).

2.3 Each party shall bear its own costs in performing its obligations under this Section.

2.4 The parties shall meet quarterly to review performance against the Forecast and to agree corrective measures where required.

2.5 Neither party shall be deemed to have waived any right by failing to enforce it on any occasion.

2.6 Any dispute arising under this Section shall first be escalated to the parties' respective operations directors.

2.7 Distributor shall maintain records sufficient to evidence compliance and shall retain them for seven (7) years.

2.8 Supplier may audit such records on thirty (30) days written notice, not more than once per calendar year.
